project.name: Halloran Street mixed-use, 40-44 Halloran Street
project.summary: The base project cut to a three-storey shop-top building: three ground-floor shell shops under 18 apartments on two levels, over one basement level of parking (30 spaces), rise in storeys of 3 and not sprinklered. DA to the Local Planning Panel, AS 4902 D&C lump sum with novation; budget $10,800,000 ex GST; the builder provides HBCF insurance.
